$comment: Small-game budgets (decision 0137). size: the game package of each example (mtek build --release --itch), the folder and the zip, in bytes; checked in CI by scripts/game-budgets.mjs size, which also fails when an example directory has no entry here. frame: p95 frame time of scripts/record-frame-evidence.mjs on a real GPU; checked by scripts/game-budgets.mjs frames, never on a software adapter. Raise a budget only in a reviewed commit that says why. Size budgets were re-baselined on 2026-10-23 (Windows, main d28886b8 plus the green-main fixes) as the measured size plus 10 %, rounded up to 10 kB: the runtime had grown about 13 % since 2026-10-21 and pulse-cube and modular-scene were over budget. The four game examples (small-game, sprite-pop, lane-runner, stage-show) were added then. Platform runtime increment (decision 0193): the new GPU/animation/extension/content/render APIs add 34,007 bytes to the minified runtime and 6,095 bytes to its public declarations (40,102 bytes total, measured against the previous embedded runtime). Non-physics package limits increase by a fixed 40,000 bytes to admit that concrete feature cost while preserving approximately the existing headroom; physics-playground retains its existing limit. This is a feature-scope budget change for review, not a performance improvement claim. Character movement example (decision 0218): added with the measured size of 2026-10-27 (folder 5,289,885 B, zip 5,291,427 B, the runtime and the physics module included, like physics-playground) plus 10 %, rounded up to 10 kB; no other budget changed.
